about_the_game:
Explore the depths

You are the last explorer of an ancient ocean, tasked with uncovering the lost songs of a forgotten people. The abyss holds sunken ruins, enigmatic creatures, and secrets buried deep in silence. Your mission: listen, observe, understand… and bring this world back to life.

Your only tools: your senses

No weapons, no maps, no set path. Decode and harness the ancient songs to open new ways, soothe or command the creatures, and connect the scattered fragments of a world in decline. You are guided by your curiosity, your eyes, and your ears.

Unravel its mysteries

What happened to the ancient peoples? What lies beyond the currents no one has ever crossed? How can you find the lost songs… and learn to use them to control the creatures still roaming the depths? The answers await you, hidden within the ocean’s whispers.

name: Wavekin

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 | AMD FX-4350
  • Graphics: Nvidia 450 GTS / Radeon HD 5750
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Wavekin is a narrative adventure and underwater exploration game where you dive into the depths to discover an ancient civilization. Observe, listen, and use your song to unravel the ocean’s mysteries and breathe new life into a world on the brink of silence.
supported_languages:
English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*
*languages with full audio support
